proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d e f x y hD
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    constructor
    · rw [eq_div_iff hD, ← h1, ← h2]
      ring
    · rw [eq_div_iff hD, ← h1, ← h2]
      ring
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · have hs : a * ((e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c)) + b * ((a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)) = (a * (e * d - b * f) + b * (a * f - e * c)) / (a * d - b * c) := by ring
      rw [hs, div_eq_iff hD]
      ring
    · have hs : c * ((e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c)) + d * ((a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)) = (c * (e * d - b * f) + d * (a * f - e * c)) / (a * d - b * c) := by ring
      rw [hs, div_eq_iff hD]
      ring
target_source: ∀ (a b c d e f x y : ℝ), a * d - b * c ≠ 0 → ((a * x + b * y = e ∧ c * x + d * y = f) ↔ (x = (e * d - b * f) / (a * d - b * c) ∧ y = (a * f - e * c) / (a * d - b * c)))
